req.title: Reject wrong method on /patch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than PATCH on /patch.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /patch must accept PATCH and reject all other HTTP methods with 405. I design: (1) a positive test confirming PATCH returns 200 with expected JSON keys, (2) negative tests for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE each expecting exactly 405, (3) a boundary/decision-table test covering the full set of disallowed methods systematically. Each test uses exact status-code assertions to catch comparison-operator mutations, and the positive test asserts JSON payload keys to catch route-handler mutations.

tests.name: test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload():
    r = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in body

test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload()

tests.name: test_all_non_patch_methods_return_405_decision_table
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD requests to /patch
trace: R-HTTPBIN-009 decision table: only PATCH is allowed; all others are 405
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_non_patch_methods_return_405_decision_table():
    disallowed = [
        client.get('/patch'),
        client.post('/patch'),
        client.put('/patch'),
        client.delete('/patch'),
        client.head('/patch'),
    ]
    for resp in disallowed:
        assert resp.status_code == 405
    allowed = client.patch('/patch')
    assert allowed.status_code == 200
    assert allowed.status_code != 405

test_all_non_patch_methods_return_405_decision_table()

tests.name: test_patch_with_json_body_returns_200_and_echoes_json
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send PATCH request to /patch with JSON body {"key": "value"}
trace: R-HTTPBIN-009 positive path with payload: PATCH /patch with body -> 200 + echoed json
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_with_json_body_returns_200_and_echoes_json():
    payload = {"key": "value"}
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data=json.dumps(payload),
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] == {"key": "value"}

test_patch_with_json_body_returns_200_and_echoes_json()
